class: registered re-analysis; a fold repair of two frozen V1 re-analyses; zero model calls; zero native runs; pure Python
frozen: 2026-09-04, before the V2 rollup was computed; the twin census counts below were measured before the freeze and are asserted by a must-fire control

supersedes_with_withdrawal.E40_CHANNEL_INFORMATION_BOUND_DESIGN_V1: IB1/IB2 verdicts (FB8 rho 0.220 p 0.019; CFG rho 0.324 p 0.003) WITHDRAWN to CANNOT_CHECK -- computed on contaminated folds
supersedes_with_withdrawal.E40_RANKER_SHIPPING_REANALYSIS_DESIGN_V1: recovered fraction 0.41 and the RS1 p 0.0585 WITHDRAWN to CANNOT_CHECK; the RS negative terminal is re-derived here under clean folds rather than kept on a favourable-direction argument

defect.what: the m2/m3 substrate is deterministic (same config => same native run => identical truth); 15 exact configurations (dataset, regime, frac, model_seed, partial_intervention_seed) were executed in more than one chain, so 39 of 144 rows have a byte-identical run in ANOTHER chain
defect.how_it_contaminated_v1: leave-one-chain-out held out one chain while its twin rows sat in the training fold, so 'out of sample' saw the sample it scored in 27 percent of its rows; the direction of the bias is FAVOURABLE to the ranker
defect.why_the_pre_run_audit_missed_it: the audit asked whether the contrast could exist and whether the clause was reachable; it did not ask whether the held-out stimulus had an exact twin across the fold boundary
defect.ledger_class: HELD_OUT_SAMPLE_HAS_A_TWIN_IN_THE_FOLD (appended to FAILURE_LEDGER.md with this design)

the_one_change: for a held-out chain, the training fold excludes every row whose exact configuration equals any configuration in the held-out chain; nothing else changes
inherited_unchanged_from_v1: ridge regression, lambda 1.0, columns standardised on the training fold
plant: run_time := truth + N(0, 0.25 sd), seed 20260904, min rho 0.5 / min recovered fraction 0.75
RS pairing, contrasts P0-P4, gates RS0-RS4 and routing, primary kind FB8+CFG

controls_evaluated_first_and_consumed_by.TWIN_CENSUS_FIRES: the census must reproduce 15 configs / 39 rows with identical truth in every twin group -- the defect detector must fire on the real data
controls_evaluated_first_and_consumed_by.V2_FOLD_HAS_NO_TWIN: for every held-out chain, the training fold size equals all-other-rows minus the twin rows, recounted from the rows rather than from the filter
controls_evaluated_first_and_consumed_by.NULL_CALIBRATION: inherited, evaluated under V2 folds (IB and RS separately)

gates_and_routing: inherited verbatim from the two V1 designs; the V2 terminals replace the withdrawn V1 terminals

reachability_audit_pre_run.contrast_could_exist: yes: removing at most a handful of rows from a 140-row fold leaves the ranker fittable; the plant must still fire and the shuffled null must still sit near zero
reachability_audit_pre_run.clause_reachable_both_ways: IB1/IB2/IB3 and RS1/RS2 each satisfiable (the plant) and failable (the null calibration)
reachability_audit_pre_run.held_out_sample_has_a_twin: NO by construction, asserted by V2_FOLD_HAS_NO_TWIN
reachability_audit_pre_run.residual_nonindependence_disclosed: chains sharing dataset and rep are still correlated substrate draws even when their configs differ; this is legitimate substrate structure (the configuration prior), not a twin, and it is what CFG measures

no_rescue: no constant, gate, threshold, seed or routing row changes after the V2 rollup is computed; the V1 rollups are not edited; their verdicts are withdrawn in the receipt and the registry
